correctness.rationale: The Laurent determinant has two independent coefficients. Cyclicity proves nonvanishing cofactors at every resonator pole; its strictly increasing root Green function gives exactly m simple interlacing solutions and no others. The decoupled Bloch fiber at z=-1 fixes ordered rank; nonzero arrowhead couplings prove simplicity for every other momentum and compactness gives the gap. The explicit degree-one polynomial eigenvector is valid and the lower block equation rules out one-cell states. Symbolic and numerical checker replayed successfully on the actual verify.py source.
